system.description:
• Effect: At-will ranged cantrip (60ft range; V, S).
  • The target makes a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half your Warlock level (minimum 1) + Cha modifier), taking force damage on a failure or half on a success. No slot required.
  • A blast hits a creature that fails its save against it.
  • Damage scales: 1d6 at 1st, 1d8 at 5th, 2d8 at 9th, 3d8 at 13th, 4d8 at 17th, 5d8 at 21st. From 17th level, Eldritch Blast fires two blasts, at the same creature or different ones within range, each with its own save.
  • Agonising Blast: from 2nd level, add your Charisma modifier to one blast's damage each round.
  • Riders: a feature of yours that adds dice or an effect to Eldritch Blast adds it to one blast each round, and a blast carries only one such rider (see Advantage & Disadvantage in Book I); Repelling Blast's push is the exception and applies to every blast that hits.
